reviews.review:
If you are a fan of escape rooms and using clues to open lock boxes for more clues, while also getting a glimpse of something more going on behind the scenes...? Then this game might be for you! As an avid puzzle enjoyer I was more than happy to jump in and see what I could find.

There were a few puzzles in here that stumped me for a good while. I tend to wander and stubbornly keep looking at the same info over and over for *far* longer than is reasonable, leading to my absurd 8 hours of playtime, but most of the instances of that were my own fault for overlooking or dismissing a connection here or there. But over all the experience was quite enjoyable and many of the other puzzles were satisfying to work through otherwise.

This is clearly a small team with a particular vision for a puzzle game experience that I found quite enjoyable. There is some clear inspiration from a few other Puzzle games, but nothing that is so overt as to warrant spoiling to point out. Just that the Devs clearly like puzzles and wanted to take a crack at their own. 

Its clear why the team launched in Early Access, there is some polish needed, and some puzzle tweaks that I think would help some of them play a little smoother to a wider number of people, but that is what Early Access is for, right?

I give it a solid 7/10.

I will happily be back to see what the Devs come up with to advance the story in the coming months!
